scientific_hypothesis.statement: After total-goals and 1X2 are fixed, the remaining identifiable exact-score degrees of freedom are allocations among scorelines sharing the same total goals and the same H/D/A outcome. Team-role history can contain pre-match residual information about narrow versus severe scorelines beyond the frozen competition-level joint-score shape.

constraints: preserve every frozen V3.1.1 total-goals marginal exactly
preserve frozen V3.2.4 target H/D/A probabilities exactly
canonical_target_matrix.construction: deterministic KL I-projection of frozen V3.1.1 matrix onto total-goals plus target-HDA constraints
canonical_target_matrix.purpose: define the unique frozen partition-mass seed before margin-severity residuals; not a tunable score-shape candidate

partitions.outcome_class: H if home_goals>away_goals, D if equal, A if home_goals<away_goals
partitions.eligible: only partitions containing at least two finite-support score cells
partitions.singleton_rule: exact identity: partitions with one cell are never modified
partitions.partition_mass_rule: candidate preserves the canonical target matrix mass of every single (T,outcome) partition exactly

severity_state.chronology: ONLY source matches with kickoff strictly earlier than target kickoff; same-kickoff excluded
target_sources: target_home_team prior home matches in native home-away score orientation
target_away_team prior away matches in native home-away score orientation
severity_state.team_role_posterior: within each eligible (T,outcome) partition, Jeffreys posterior score-cell probabilities (count+0.5)/(partition_count+0.5*K)
severity_state.league_reference_posterior: same-league strictly-earlier Jeffreys posterior in the same partition; if no earlier league observation, use big5 strictly-earlier pool; if still absent, residual is neutral
severity_state.team_residual: team_role_posterior / league_reference_posterior cellwise; if team role has no earlier observation in that partition, residual is neutral 1 for every cell
severity_state.two_source_combination: cellwise geometric mean of home-team-home and away-team-away residual factors (equal log weight 50/50)
severity_state.minimum_observation_threshold: NONE; only zero versus positive partition observation determines neutral residual

candidate_construction.step_1: build canonical target matrix from frozen V3.1.1 + frozen V3.2.4 HDA constraints
candidate_construction.step_2: for each eligible (T,outcome) partition multiply canonical cell probabilities by the frozen combined team-role residual factors
candidate_construction.step_3: renormalize only inside that same (T,outcome) partition back to its exact canonical partition mass
candidate_construction.step_4: leave every singleton partition byte-for-byte numerically identical within floating tolerance
candidate_construction.high_score_or_low_score_selection: NONE; all and only multi-cell partitions use the same residual rule

forbidden: changing 50/50 source combination after target scoring
adding partition-specific exceptions after target scoring
using target-period outcomes to fit residuals
manual match team league fold score or cell exceptions
